response.description:
Azure Firewall now supports IPv6 in public
preview, enabling customers to configure Azure Firewall and Firewall Policy in
dual-stack mode for both IPv4 and IPv6 traffic. This preview allows native IPv6
network-rule filtering and DNS Proxy support, helping organizations secure
cloud, hybrid, and internal IPv6 traffic as they modernize toward dual-stack
architectures. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Ipv6 support in Azure Firewall
